hardRule.statement: one connected cliff contour uses one uniform structural tier delta all the way around each same-delta edge: 1-high stays 1-high, 2-high stays 2-high, 3-high stays 3-high, 4-high stays 4-high
hardRule.specialConnectors: ramps/ladders/caves/waterfalls may replace/open a local recipe but do not silently change the surrounding cliff tier delta

verticalRecipe.bottomParity: straight, diagonal and terminal recipes at the same tier delta terminate on the same receiver row

w12Regression.symptom: stair-step diagonal cliff chains visually collapsed to a thin one-block band while adjacent flat faces kept their full modular height
w12Regression.cause: diagonal shoulder/body/foot visibility was evaluated against the raised host column; on a diagonal that column can remain plateau-height and wrongly occlude the low-side wall projection
w12Regression.correction: south-west diagonal projection evaluates visibility against x-1 low-side receivers; south-east evaluates against x+1; authored pixels remain drawn at their original host-aligned source footprint

collisionParity: south-face collision depth is derived from the same uniform receiver-row helper for every same-delta south family
